cell.label: Clinical suspicion of ventilator-associated pneumonia. Obtain lower respiratory tract cultures. Potential for multidrug-resistant (MDR) pathogens (see Table 2)?
Focused antibiotic therapy: ceftriaxone, levofloxacin, moxifloxacin, ampicillin/sulbactam, or ertapenem.
Broad-spectrum antibiotic therapy: antipseudomonal cephalosporin, carbapenem, or beta-lactam/beta-lactamase inhibitor, plus a fluoroquinolone or aminoglycoside, plus vancomycin or linezolid for MRSA.
Day 2 and 3: check cultures and assess clinical response (temperature, WBC, chest x-ray, purulent sputum, oxygenation, hemodynamic changes, and organ function). Clinical improvement at 48-72 hours?
Search for other pathogens, complications, other sites of infection, or other diagnoses.
Adjust antibiotics. Search for other pathogens, complications, other sites of infection, or other diagnoses.
De-escalate antibiotics if possible; treat for 7-8 days, except patients with Pseudomonas aeruginosa.
